classification.difficultyReason: Select and sequence sine rule, cosine rule and angle sums for different sets of givens; the SSA parts explicitly require the obtuse supplementary branch.

content.prompt: Calculate the lengths of the unknown sides and the sizes of the unknown angles, correct to two decimal places.

spec.description: Triangle with A lower left, B lower right and C above; source angle labels have no arcs.
spec.mathematics: AB=7 cm; A=51 degrees; B=38 degrees.

spec.description: Triangle with the two given sides meeting at A.
spec.mathematics: AC=4 cm; AB=6 cm; A=48 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}BC^2&=4^2+6^2-2(4)(6)\cos48^\circ\\BC&=\sqrt{52-48\cos48^\circ}\\BC&\approx4.46\text{ cm}\\\cos C&=\frac{4^2+BC^2-6^2}{2(4)(BC)}\\\angle C&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{16+BC^2-36}{8BC}\right)\\\angle C&\approx90.19^\circ\\\angle B&=180^\circ-48^\circ-\angle C\\\angle B&\approx41.81^\circ\end{align*}$$
Use the unrounded value of $BC$ throughout.

spec.description: Triangle with included 80-degree angle at C.
spec.mathematics: AC=10 cm; BC=7 cm; C=80 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}AB^2&=10^2+7^2-2(10)(7)\cos80^\circ\\AB&=\sqrt{149-140\cos80^\circ}\\AB&\approx11.17\text{ cm}\\\frac{\sin A}{7}&=\frac{\sin80^\circ}{AB}\\\angle A&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{7\sin80^\circ}{AB}\right)\\\angle A&\approx38.12^\circ\\\angle B&=180^\circ-80^\circ-\angle A\\\angle B&\approx61.88^\circ\end{align*}$$
Use the unrounded value of $AB$ throughout.

spec.description: C lies above and right of B; B is obtuse.
spec.mathematics: AB=10 cm; BC=12 cm; B=120 degrees.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Use the configuration shown, with $\angle B$ obtuse.

spec.description: Preserves the source's obtuse-B SSA configuration, with C above and right of B.
spec.mathematics: AC=15 cm; BC=8 cm; A=31 degrees; B obtuse.

answer.short:
$\angle B\approx105.05^\circ$, $\angle C\approx43.95^\circ$, $AB\approx10.78\text{ cm}$.

Choose the supplementary sine-rule angle because $B$ is obtuse.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin B}{15}&=\frac{\sin31^\circ}{8}\\\sin B&=\frac{15\sin31^\circ}{8}\\\angle B&=180^\circ-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{15\sin31^\circ}{8}\right)\\\angle B&\approx105.05^\circ\\\angle C&=180^\circ-31^\circ-\angle B\\\angle C&\approx43.95^\circ\\\frac{AB}{\sin C}&=\frac{8}{\sin31^\circ}\\AB&=\frac{8\sin C}{\sin31^\circ}\\AB&\approx10.78\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The diagram specifies the obtuse value of $B$. Keep both angles unrounded until the final answers.

spec.description: A bottom left, B upper right, C left of B; preserves the obtuse-C configuration.
spec.mathematics: AC=15 cm; AB=25 cm; B=18 degrees; C obtuse.

answer.short:
$\angle C\approx149.00^\circ$, $\angle A\approx13.00^\circ$, $BC\approx10.92\text{ cm}$.

Choose the supplementary sine-rule angle because $C$ is obtuse.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin C}{25}&=\frac{\sin18^\circ}{15}\\\sin C&=\frac{25\sin18^\circ}{15}\\\angle C&=180^\circ-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{25\sin18^\circ}{15}\right)\\\angle C&\approx149.00^\circ\\\angle A&=180^\circ-18^\circ-\angle C\\\angle A&\approx13.00^\circ\\\frac{BC}{\sin A}&=\frac{15}{\sin18^\circ}\\BC&=\frac{15\sin A}{\sin18^\circ}\\BC&\approx10.92\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The diagram specifies the obtuse value of $C$. Keep both angles unrounded until the final answers.
